The TBS group is stable under a variety of reaction conditions, including acidic and basic environments, making it useful for multi-step syntheses. It can be removed (deprotected) using fluoride sources such as tetrabutylammonium fluoride (TBAF) or by acidic hydrolysis, regenerating the free alcohol.
